name: @jichaowang/harness-graph
description: 面向本地编码 Agent 的声明式 Workflow 编译与校验工具。

scripts.check:all: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && node dist/cli.js activate --check
scripts.doctor: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js doctor
scripts.workflow:validate: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js validate
scripts.workflow:diagram: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js diagram
scripts.workflow:image: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js image
scripts.workflow:ui: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js ui
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch && npm run release:push
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && npm run release:push
scripts.release:major: npm version major && npm run release:push
scripts.workflow:sync: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js sync
scripts.workflow:activate: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js activate
scripts.workflow:start: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js start
scripts.workflow:continue: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js continue
scripts.workflow:cancel: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js cancel
scripts.project:check: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js project-check
scripts.prepack: npm run build && node --input-type=module -e "import { checkWorkflowCatalog } from './dist/workflow/catalog.js'; await checkWorkflowCatalog({ rootDir: process.cwd() });"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run check:all && npm run project:check
